annotations.text: Main: the live SfN 2026 page. Frosted glass buttons, glass icon chips, card hover glow, and a Biotium Choice badge glow (blue) throughout — the committed glass direction, same as GlassVariant.
GlassVariant: kept as a reference copy alongside Main now that its glass treatment has been committed to the live page. Content and behavior are otherwise identical to Main.

QuietFieldVariant: same as Main, but the hero's static neuron photo is replaced with a live ambient canvas — a dot-and-line neuron network, off-white background, quiet/sparse on the left behind the copy and thickening into a dense synapse-like tangle on the right. It isn't interactive (so touches scroll the page normally); instead, about every two seconds a single random neuron pulses biotium blue and lights its connections as it fades. On top of the network's dense side sits an interactive particle brain in Biotium red and blue (about 10k particles sampled from hero-brain.webp): the particles drift in and assemble on load, push away from the mouse (or a finger dragged across the brain) and spring back, and ripple out from a click or tap; swipes that start off the brain still scroll and reduced motion shows it still, anchored to the hero's right edge on desktop and centered under the copy on mobile. The Come say hi section has circular team faces (five headshots plus placeholders) that pop in when it scrolls into view and float gently around the copy; on narrower screens they line up in a row above it.

BrainVariant: same as Main, but the hero is a two-column layout and the hero visual is a slowly rotating wireframe brain (procedural folded hemispheres + cerebellum, raw WebGL with hidden-line removal, no external libraries), anchored to the hero's right edge on desktop and centered under the hero copy on mobile. Decorative only; static frame for reduced-motion or software-rendered WebGL.
